categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the water conservancy and municipal water supply and drainage sectors, providing professional technical services including surveying and design, planning consulting, project operation and management, and other related services. It also engages in engineering construction and information technology services through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as Building Information Modeling (BIM), Geographic Information Systems (GIS), digital twin technology, and ecological engineering for water environment restoration. It emphasizes integrated water lifecycle solutions, smart water management platforms, and innovative water treatment technologies including membrane bioreactors and ecological control techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government water bureaus, municipal authorities, construction and engineering firms, and environmental management entities primarily within China. Major markets are focused on urban water supply, flood control, water environment governance, and rural water conservancy projects, with a strong presence in Guangdong Province and expanding nationwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Guangdong Province, especially Shenzhen and the Greater Bay Area, with growing business in other provinces and some international projects. It has subsidiaries and branch offices in multiple Chinese cities and aims to expand its market footprint nationally and along the Belt and Road Initiative regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily as a midstream service provider in the water infrastructure supply chain, offering engineering design, consulting, project management, and operational services. It does not manufacture physical products but supports upstream construction and downstream operation through technical and management expertise.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing full lifecycle water service capabilities, integrating design with big data and scientific research, and developing new business areas such as smart water operations, AI water technologies, and water-soil-carbon sequestration. The company invests significantly in R&D projects focused on ecological restoration, water quality improvement, carbon emission reduction, and digital water management platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through contract-based professional service fees from surveying, design, consulting, project operation, and construction services. The company employs bidding and direct commission sales models, with income recognized based on project progress and service delivery milestones.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading water conservancy engineering design firms in China, holding multiple top-tier qualifications and recognized as the first A-share listed company specializing in water conservancy surveying and design. It competes with major state-owned and specialized design institutes, maintaining a strong market position in Guangdong and the South China region.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 854.7 million RMB, an 11.14% increase from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about 52.8 million RMB, reversing prior losses. Total assets reached nearly 2 billion RMB, with steady growth in cash flow and equity, reflecting a positive growth trajectory and improved profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through comprehensive full-process consulting services covering the entire water project lifecycle, advanced technological integration (BIM, GIS, digital twins), and innovative ecological and smart water management solutions. Its strong local government relationships, extensive qualifications, and commitment to R&D enable it to deliver tailored, high-quality, and sustainable water infrastructure solutions.
